extDescription.message: A powerful Pixiv batch downloader. It can batch download illustrations, manga, animated works, and novels; filter works, set file names, save by category, and improve the Pixiv experience.

command_start_default_crawl.message: Click the default crawl button (start crawling)

command_quick_download.message: Quickly download the current work on a work page

command_quick_bookmark.message: Quickly bookmark the current work on a work page

command_copy_work_info.message: Copy the work's images and summary info
